limitations.minutes_independence: V1 estimates its hit rate over appearances without conditioning on the minutes bin. V2 thins linearly by expected minutes exposure. Neither is conditioned on the bin the composer later draws.
limitations.poisson_shape: V2 converts an expected DC count into a threshold probability through a Poisson, which understates the probability for a player well below the threshold and overstates it well above, because real defensive actions cluster. Correcting it needs a measured over-dispersion parameter, which one season cannot support.
limitations.single_season: DC exists in 2025-26 only, so there is no cross-season generalisation evidence available from this archive at all, whatever the result.
limitations.small_transferred_slice: Measured 242 transfer stints across five seasons, so roughly 48 in one season, and only the post-transfer appearances of those players are informative. The transferred slice will be small and its confidence interval wide; report the row count beside every figure and do not treat a narrow margin on it as decided.
